description: Suggest a new listing for the Agent Switchboard directory. This opens a PUBLIC GitHub issue that the maintainer reviews by hand; it does not publish anything. Use it only when the user asks to submit or list a product, after you show them the name, URL, and description you will send and they agree. Call search_agents first: if the product is already listed, tell the user instead. Limited to 5 submissions per hour per caller and one per URL per day.

access.description: How agents reach it: api, mcp, cli, browser-extension

contact_email.description: Optional. Sent privately to the maintainer for follow-up, never posted. Only include an address the user gave you for this purpose.

description.description: What it does and who it is for, in plain words (20–1500 characters)

url.description: The product's own homepage, docs, or GitHub repo (https)

name: submit_listing
title: Submit a Listing
